packageRules.description: The desktop backend and provider original-module versions are overridden by intentional local/provenance replacements; review replacements explicitly.
Angular compiler-cli 22.2.4 requires TypeScript >=6.0 <6.1; advance TypeScript with a validated Angular compiler migration.
Keep Jasmine core and declarations on the major supported by karma-jasmine; change the engine, adapter and declarations together.
The existing server uses the maintained v2 bug/security-fix series. A v3 upgrade requires explicit imports, callbacks and flag migration; do not add an unused v3 module.
